title: Fixed-width binary outer-join null materialization
hypothesis: A compact columnar engine can expose an outer-join repair that must carry row-match state consistently through physical bytes, validity bitmaps, selection, and projection.
why_hard: Unused slot bytes can remain present while the value is null; valid all-zero bytes must remain values. Fixing displayed bytes alone cannot make null predicates and later operations agree.
next_action: Prototype the generic fixed-binary gather path and an independent nested-loop reference; check unmatched rows, empty inputs, repeated keys, multi-batch behavior, and the documented gather trace before a Terra/high screen.

sources.note: Recorded incorrect-result reproducer: an unmatched right-side fixed-size binary key appears non-null after a left join. Use as failure-shape provenance, not transplanted code.

notes: Ranked first within the runtime research shortlist, which explicitly records no created task or model trial. The compact representation may still make the defect obvious; a worked oracle and observed trajectories must establish whether it is worth promotion.
